_note: Synthetic recorded resolutions for resolved Contoso Dental tickets (B-58). Invented for this prototype: what a technician wrote down when closing the ticket. Keyed by ticket id into the dated Contoso Dental ticket set (B-21). Some records are deliberately awkward (a record naming another client, a ticket that is not a Contoso ticket, a ticket not resolved, an empty resolution, a poisoned ticket) to exercise the draft rules. Not a capture from a real PSA.

records.title: Reset multi-factor methods after a phone change
steps: Verify the user by calling back the number on file (555-0142) before changing anything.
Reset the multi-factor methods for priya.nair@contosodental.example in the admin portal.
Ask Priya Nair to sign in and register the new Authenticator app.
Confirm a sign-in succeeds, then note the result in the ticket.

records.title: Sign-in codes still go to an old phone number
steps: Open the user's authentication methods and remove the old phone number.
Add the new number only after the user answers a call-back on the number on file.
Reference phrase for this draft: zebra-b58-contoso-only.

Restart the print spooler service on the reception workstation.
Print a test chart for patient Marisol Quintero, DOB 04/11/1987, member 12-3456-7890, then discard it.
Close the ticket once the test page prints for [PATIENT_NAME_1] and a second user.
